findings.issue: １７歳 (age 17) is read じゅうななさい (or じゅうしちさい), never digit-by-digit いちなな. The kana teaches a wrong reading of the number+counter.
findings.current: らいねんでいちななさいになるんだ。
findings.suggested: らいねんでじゅうななさいになるんだ。

findings.issue: Token １７ has reading いちなな (digit-by-digit); in １７歳 the number is read じゅうなな.
Romaji propagates the wrong digit-by-digit reading ichinana for １７歳; should be juunana.
Same reading error as 78591: １７歳 must be じゅうななさい, not いちななさい.
findings.current: らいげついちななさいになるのですか。
findings.suggested: らいげつじゅうななさいになるのですか。

findings.issue: Token １７ has reading いちなな; in １７歳 the number is read じゅうなな.
Romaji propagates the wrong reading ichinana for １７歳; should be juunana.
Sense-breaking corruption: 来週の今ごろ means 'about this time next week'; 'next party' is nonsense and matches nothing in the Japanese.
findings.current: I will be flying about this time next party.
findings.suggested: I will be flying about this time next week.

findings.issue: 来る日 = 'the coming day' (attributive 来る), not 'the day before' — the literal gloss inverts the time direction and contradicts expl_en and lit_pt ('dia que vem').
findings.current: The day before (too) and the day before that (too), it was rain (datta).
findings.suggested: The coming day (too) and the coming day (too), it was rain (datta).

findings.issue: Literal rendering drops まで ('until') and invents 'is fine' (which would be でいい, not まで+なんだ); it fails to mirror the actual structure Xまで+な(の)だ+けど.
findings.current: Monday or Tuesday of next week is fine, you know, but...
findings.suggested: Until Monday or Tuesday of next week it is, you know, but...

findings.issue: 何十万人 = hundreds of thousands of people, not 'millions' (an order of magnitude off); pt and lit_en both correctly say hundreds of thousands.
findings.current: Next week, millions of people will be watching the TV program.
findings.suggested: Next week, hundreds of thousands of people will be watching the TV program.

findings.issue: Explanation glosses 何十万人もの人 as 'tens of thousands of people'; 何十万 = hundreds of thousands (tens of 万). Contradicts the token gloss and lit_en.
findings.current: The subject is 何十万人もの人 ('tens of thousands of people')
findings.suggested: The subject is 何十万人もの人 ('hundreds of thousands of people')

findings.issue: Explanation glosses 何十万人もの人 as 'dezenas de milhares de pessoas'; 何十万 = centenas de milhares. Contradicts the pt translation itself ('centenas de milhares').
findings.current: O sujeito é 何十万人もの人 ('dezenas de milhares de pessoas')
findings.suggested: O sujeito é 何十万人もの人 ('centenas de milhares de pessoas')

findings.issue: Missing space before the parenthesis in the pt gloss: 'dia(saudação'.
findings.current: passe bem; tenha um bom dia(saudação de despedida)
findings.suggested: passe bem; tenha um bom dia (saudação de despedida)

findings.issue: English word 'Coverage' left in the pt-BR learner-facing explanation; the parallel sentence 78608 uses 'cobertura'.
findings.current: Coverage de N5: uso de から temporal + sujeito com が + verbo intransitivo.
findings.suggested: Cobertura de N5: uso de から temporal + sujeito com が + verbo intransitivo.

findings.issue: Declarative だろう expresses supposition ('probably'), not self-questioning 'I wonder' (that reading belongs to だろうか); the tag conflicts with the (correct) explanation.
findings.current: As for next month, it'll be very busy, I wonder.
findings.suggested: As for next month, it'll probably be very busy.

findings.issue: この is strictly proximal ('this'); the alternative 'that' does not fit このアパート in this sentence (pt 'este, esse' is defensible in BR usage, but en 'that' is not).
